loaded_files.description: Every file actually opened, rooted exactly at skill/ or project/memory/; use skill/SKILL.md without an inserted skill-name directory, and include every recalled_records path.

recalled_records.description: Canonical detail records actually opened, in sequential open order; top 3 is an upper bound and every path must also appear in loaded_files.

fact_ids.description: Exact first-class fact identifiers only; never prose.

decision_id.description: Exact Decision.choice identifier only; never a fact identifier or prose.

contradiction_detected.description: True exactly when loaded authoritative records expose an unresolved contradiction.

contradiction_id.description: Exact first-class contradiction identifier only; never explanatory prose.

next_action_id.description: Exact next-action or required-check identifier only.

resume_success.description: Whether the requested continuation state and next action were recovered.

abstained.description: True when authoritative memory does not contain the requested answer.

answer.description: Human-readable answer; identifiers remain in their typed fields.
